Research trajectories
for frontier AI.

We partner with university labs to capture how research happens: forming hypotheses, designing experiments, navigating failures, and deciding what to try next. We focus on the intuition, reasoning, and judgment behind the work, then turn these trajectories into training and evaluation tasks that help frontier AI develop scientific reasoning.
